Simple Menu Solution for RPG Maker MZ ver 1.0.0
BitQuest Studio
Simple Menu Solution is a flexible plugin that enhances the menus, save/load screens, and system interfaces in RPG Maker MZ. Designed with usability and clean design in mind, it lets developers create streamlined layouts, hide clutter, resize windows, and move functionality (like volume control) into dedicated submenus.
Every feature can be toggled and adjusted via plugin parameters. Whether you're polishing a commercial RPG or building a jam-friendly minimalist UI, this plugin saves hours of custom coding.
Customizable Options & Menu Layouts​
Resize and Center Main Menu Commands
Redefine the dimensions and on-screen placement of the command menu window.
Hide Actor Display in Main Menu
Remove the actor status window for a cleaner, non-character-focused UI.
Disable Unused Commands
Prevent access to broken systems like Skill, Equip, Status, or Formation when the actor window is hidden (see Usage Notes below).
Toggle Gold Display
Easily enable or disable the gold count window in the bottom-right corner.
Streamlined Options Menu​
Remove “Command Remember”
Trim unnecessary or unused options for a more focused settings interface.
Resize the Options Menu
Adjust the width and height of the default Options window to match your desired screen layout.
Dedicated Audio Submenu​
Consolidate BGM, BGS, ME, and SE Volume
Move all volume controls into a standalone “Audio” submenu inside the Options menu.
Independent Size Controls
Set custom width and height values for the Audio submenu independently of the Options screen.
Fully Integrated Navigation
The Audio submenu appears as a selectable item in the Options menu. No patches or rewrites needed.
Enhanced Save & Load UI​
Resize the Save/Load List Window
Customize the window size to better fit your layout or show more information.
Hide Actor Sprites in Save Slots
Focus solely on gameplay metadata - no character portraits or sprite clutter.
Playtime Inline with File Label
Display total play duration directly next to each savefile name (e.g., “File 1 - 12:34:56”).
Save Timestamp as a Second Line
Show the local date and time the save was made, formatted automatically using the player’s locale.
Streamlined Layout
Save/load windows are centered and padded for improved readability and balance.
Navigation Control​
Toggle Top-Right Back Button
Remove the small “X” button from scenes if you're using keyboard/gamepad navigation or custom HUDs.
No Forced Inputs
All default RPG Maker MZ behavior remains untouched unless features are explicitly toggled off.
Screenshots​
How to Use
Simply place the plugin into your js/plugins folder and configure the parameters. With plug-and-play simplicity, you'll have your menu how you like it in a few clicks!
Plugin Commands / Script Calls
None
Terms of Use
Free to use in commercial and non-commercial projects
Attribution to BitQuest Studio is appreciated but not required
Download
Itch.io

Version 1.1.0 is here, and it transforms the default RPG Maker MZ menu into something you’ll actually want to show off. Whether you're aiming for a modern, minimalist UI or a fully illustrated, stylized experience, this update gives you the tools to make it happen fast.
️
Visual Customization That Pops
​
Frame Toggle Mode
Clean up your menu’s appearance by hiding the default window frame.
Image-Based Buttons
Replace any menu button (like “Item” or “Save”) with a custom image from your img/system/ folder. No scripting needed.
Custom Menu Decorations
Add up to 4 decorative images anywhere on the screen when the menu opens. Use this for background art, flourishes, or animated accents.
Smarter Layout Options
​
Horizontal Toolbar Layout
Ditch the default vertical list. You can now switch to a sleek horizontal menu bar. Perfect for clean, modern layouts.
Adjustable Button Sizes
Set the exact width and height of each button in horizontal mode to fit your design.
Automatic Sizing
The menu window resizes itself to fit all buttons in horizontal mode.
Animated Transitions
​
Add polish with smooth, built-in animations when opening and closing the menu:
Slide
: Slides in from the side
Zoom:
Grows from small to full size
Fade
: Soft fade in/out
Developer Tools That Save You Time
​
Get Available Commands (Plugin Command)
Logs all active menu commands in the console so you know exactly what’s available to customize or replace.
Automatic Detection
The plugin now detects and supports menu buttons added by other plugins
Why This Update Matters
​
With minimal setup, you can:
Build a menu that fits your game’s tone
Add visual polish that makes your project feel finished
Streamline development with automatic detection and easy parameter settings
Avoid compatibility issues with plugins that modify the menu
Whether you're aiming for a clean minimalist design or a flashy custom UI,
Simple Menu Solution v1.1.0
gives you the tools to make it happen. No extra coding. No hacks. Just results.
Grab the update and make your menu something worth clicking.

posts.author: bitqueststudio
posts.body:
Version 1.2 Changelog
New Features​
Helpful tooltips for every option
When you highlight a menu option, a small description appears underneath explaining what it does. All default RPG Maker options are already covered, and you can add your own descriptions if you want.
Improved background dimming (vignette effect)
The menu now darkens the edges of the screen while keeping the center clear, helping the menu stand out more naturally.
New selection effects
The currently selected option is easier to see with new styles like a soft glow or a highlighted box with a border.
Window color tinting
You can apply a subtle color tone to all menu windows for a more customized look.
Scalable menu icons
Icons can now be resized cleanly, and they stay properly centered no matter the size.
Save file screenshots
Each save file now includes a small preview image of your game at the moment you saved, making it easier to recognize saves.
Audio settings always save
Volume changes are now remembered even if you back out of the menu without confirming.
Visual volume bars
Audio settings now show easy-to-read bars instead of just numbers.
Improvements​
Smoother animations
Menu transitions like opening, closing, and switching feel more fluid and polished.
Better default visuals
Most visual enhancements are now turned on by default, so the menu looks great immediately without setup.
Bug Fixes​
Menu images stay where you put them
Fixed an issue where menu pictures ignored your positioning and snapped to corners.
Better performance with icons and effects
Reduced unnecessary processing to keep the menu running smoothly.
Fixed layout issues
Menu elements now resize and position correctly in all layouts.
Resolved save screen issues
Fixed problems with save previews causing repeated refreshes and overlapping text.
Crash when loading available commands
Fixed a crash caused by missing logic when building the command list.
Menu highlight showing up in the wrong places
The selection effect now only appears in the main menu and no longer shows in battle, shops, skills, or other screens.
Transition animation running forever
Fixed an issue where menu animations could keep running in the background instead of stopping properly.
